title: KAHRELUM Selected 30-Forecast Performance
methodology: This manually selected showcase combines scores from different, heterogeneous scoring conventions.
Good Judgment Open's categorical and daily-averaged scores are not directly comparable to KAHRELUM's one-shot binary Brier scores.
The 0.1499 figure is a descriptive arithmetic average of rounded score observations, not a standardized skill score or forecast-calibration test.
This selected subset must not be represented as KAHRELUM's full historical record or an unbiased sample.
selectionDisclosure: Selected, curated favorable records and the seven-case calibration with two misses. New Zealand and NVIDIA records, and other unfavorable older cases, are excluded from this showcase but preserved in their original archives. Excluding them changes the displayed mean.
gjoScreenshotEvidence: Seven original screenshots of authenticated GJO scores supplied by the owner; public screenshots or independently downloadable account export are not available in this repository.
